info.description:
Welcome to the Kalodata OpenAPI documentation. This API provides comprehensive data analytics and insights for e-commerce platforms including TikTok, Amazon, and Shopee.

## Authentication

This API uses API Key authentication:

### API Key Authentication
- Reach out to kalodata_us@kalowave.com to obtain your API key.
- Add your API key in the `X-API-Key` header

## Getting Started

1. Click the **Authorize** button and enter your API key
2. Try the API endpoints below
3. Each endpoint shows required permissions and rate limits

## Rate Limits

- Different endpoints have different rate limits (shown in endpoint descriptions)
- Rate limits are per API key/user account
- Contact support if you need higher limits

## Support

For technical support, please contact our API team at customerservice@kalodata.com

Retrieve ranking list of videos based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: window is capped at 30 days. Supports `lastDay`, `last7Day`, `last30Day`, a natural `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` (span ≤ 30 days), or a natural month `yyyy-MM`.

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `views`, `revenue_growth_rate`, `ads_roas`, `video_id`, `video_title`, `belonged_creator_id`, `belonged_creator_handle`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific video
Retrieve a CloudFront signed video URL by video_id. The URL expires after 5 minutes.
Retrieve all product images by product_id. URLs are CloudFront signed URLs that expire after 5 minutes.

Retrieve cached comment insight for a TikTok product. Charges 1 credit only when insight data exists and `cached_at` is newer than the last charge for this user and product. Failures and timeouts are not charged. Rate limit is 100 requests per 10 seconds.

Retrieve cached selling-point highlights and attributes for a TikTok product. When cached analysis is missing, generation is triggered asynchronously; this request still returns failure and is not charged. Charges 0.1 credit only when analysis data exists. Rate limit is 100 requests per 10 seconds.
Retrieve CloudFront signed avatar URLs for up to 100 creator IDs. URLs expire after 5 minutes.

Retrieve ranking list of shops based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: window is capped at 30 days. Supports `lastDay`, `last7Day`, `last30Day`, a natural `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` (span ≤ 30 days), or a natural month `yyyy-MM`.

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `sales_volumn`, `revenue_growth_rate`, `unit_price`, `shop_type`, `affiliate_revenue`, `self_promotion_revenue`, `shopping_mall_revenue`, `on_sell_product_count`, `rank`, `shop_id`, `shop_name`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific shop

Retrieve ranking list of products based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: window is capped at 30 days. Supports `lastDay`, `last7Day`, `last30Day`, a natural `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` (span ≤ 30 days), or a natural month `yyyy-MM`.

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `commission_rate`, `revenue_growth_rate`, `sales_volumn`, `unit_price`, `launch_date`, `live_revenue`, `video_revenue`, `showcase_revenue`, `product_id`, `product_name`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific product. The response includes product_description (structured text/image blocks; empty array when unavailable).

Retrieve ranking list of livestreams based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: window is capped at 30 days. Supports `lastDay`, `last7Day`, `last30Day`, a natural `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` (span ≤ 30 days), or a natural month `yyyy-MM`.

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `unit_price`, `views`, `livestream_start_time`, `livestream_end_time`, `livestream_duration`, `livestream_id`, `livestream_title`, `creator_id`, `creator_handle`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific livestream

Query credit consume details for the user bound to the API key. This endpoint is free of charge and limited to 10 requests per 10 seconds.

Only consume records (`quantity < 0`) are returned, where the bound user is either the deduction account or the consumer account. `sourceType` accepts aggregated consume type English names only.

Retrieve ranking list of creators based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: window is capped at 30 days. Supports `lastDay`, `last7Day`, `last30Day`, a natural `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` (span ≤ 30 days), or a natural month `yyyy-MM`.

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `revenue_growth_rate`, `content_views`, `creator_followers`, `sales_volumn`, `video_revenue`, `live_revenue`, `creator_id`, `creator_nickname`, `creator_handle`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific creator

Retrieve ranking list of categories based on specified criteria and filters.

**`date_range`**: only `last7Day`, `last30Day`, `last90Day`, `last180Day`, `last365Day` are supported (natural date ranges and months are NOT accepted here).

**`sort_field.field`**: `revenue` (default), `revenue_growth_rate`, `top3_shop_revenue_ratio`, `average_revenue`, `rank`, `category_id`, `category_name`. Default sort is `revenue DESC`.

Retrieve detailed information for a specific category.

**`date_range`**: only `last7Day`, `last30Day`, `last90Day`, `last180Day`, `last365Day` are supported (natural date ranges and months are NOT accepted here).

get.description:
Query remaining display points for the user bound to the API key. This endpoint is free of charge and limited to 10 requests per 10 seconds.

If the bound user is a sub-account, the response includes total, main-account and sub-account points. If the bound user is a main account, only total and main-account points are returned.

currency.description: Currency unit for revenue and price fields. Currently supports CNY, USD, IDR, VND, THB, MYR, JPY, PHP, GBP, SGD, MXN, EUR, BRL.

date_range.description: Date range. Accepts named ranges (lastDay, last7Day, last30Day, last60Day, last90Day, last180Day, last365Day), a natural date range in `yyyy-MM-dd~yyyy-MM-dd` form, or a natural month `yyyy-MM`. Some endpoints restrict this set — see the per-endpoint description.
